outcome: Validity (convergent, discriminant, construct) of the Korean version of the Obstetric Quality of Recovery-11 (ObsQoR-11K) score
Reliability (Cronbach's α, inter-item, split-half, and test-retest correlation) of ObsQoR-11K
Clinical feasibility of ObsQoR-11K (recruitment rate and completion time)
cohort: 120 Korean women who underwent elective cesarean section
finding: The Korean version of the ObsQoR-11 is a valid and reliable tool for assessing maternal recovery after elective cesarean section in Korean women.
